A methods paragraph from a run's record

Source: R/doc-methods-text.R
gr_methods_text.Rd

Writes what a run's record says about how it was made as one plain paragraph, for the methods section of a paper or a report: the harnessr version, the models the requests asked for and the models the provider said answered, how many requests were made and how many a cache answered, the tokens sent and received (a request a cache or a recording answered sent nothing, and its recorded tokens are given apart), the settings changed from their defaults, and a hash of each distinct system prompt, by stage. For a benchmark it adds the arms, items, runs per item and the scorer.

Usage

gr_methods_text(x)

Arguments

x

A gr_answer (its own run's steps; see gr_answer), a gr_trace, or a benchmark from hr_benchmark().

Value

A character string, one paragraph, of class gr_methods_text; print() wraps it.

Details

Everything in it is read from the record: the trace's request steps and its pre-flight notes, or the benchmark's columns and attributes. It makes no claim the record does not hold. It does not say the answers are right, and where the record lacks something (the provider did not report the model that answered, say) the paragraph says that it is not recorded. Prompt hashes are the first 12 hex digits of the SHA-256 hash harnessr keys its records with, taken of each system message, so two runs that sent the same instructions show the same hash; the full prompts stay in the trace.

See also

as_json() and gr_trace_save() for the full record, gr_audit_report() for a readable account of one answer

Other reading functions: gr_answer, gr_check_reader(), gr_read(), gr_read_spec(), gr_reader_signature(), gr_readers(), gr_register_reader(), gr_step(), is_not_found(), new_answer()

Examples

ch <- gr_segment(gr_example(), list(method = "paragraph", max_tokens = 150))
#> Using cached ingestion for this document + settings.
#> Segmenting with 'paragraph' (cap 150 tokens, overlap 0).
cl <- gr_mock_client(function(m, p) "Revenue was 45.2 million dollars.")
ans <- gr_read(ch, "What was revenue?", cl, gr_read_spec("retrieve", top_k = 3))
#> Reading with 'retrieve' (topk|1|none) over 5 chunk(s).
gr_methods_text(ans)
#> The run was made with harnessr 0.6.0.9000. It read once with the
#> 'retrieve' reader with these settings changed from their defaults:
#> top_k = 3. It made 1 model request(s), which asked for 'mock-model'.
#> The provider did not report which model answered them. They sent 478
#> prompt token(s) and received 13 reply token(s). Their system prompts,
#> by stage, have the hashes retrieve.answer cdd84211f69d. This paragraph
#> restates the run's record and makes no claim beyond it.
